# CTM (CTM4): connection register

References only. Secret values are never written here, nor in any issue, PR, chat, note or screenshot. Values stored on the agent host live in `/home/agents/.config/ctm/` (folder readable only by `agents`, files mode 600), saved only by a member with `python3 /home/agents/kit/dispatch.py secret ctm <NAME>`. Adding, changing or removing an entry is a recorded decision: change the intake (`python3 /home/agents/kit/dispatch.py set ctm …`), rebuild, sync, and run `python3 /home/agents/kit/dispatch.py check ctm`.

Besides the hosts below, agents may reach GitHub, the package registries, the published design specification and the agent host itself (plan §12.1).
